vetSays.line: 🛡️ Tikhon, Dale, Jovan and Farid met them at the door — 4 put down. Tikhon, Dale, Jovan, Farid are hurt.
🛡️ Lauren, Bessie, Tikhon and Pilar met them at the door — 4 put down. Lauren, Bessie, Tikhon are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lauren just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bessie just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lauren, Bessie, Pilar, Dale and Jovan met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Lauren, Bessie, Dale, Jovan are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Murilo just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Murilo, Giulia and Emma met them at the door — 2 put down. Emma didn't come back. Murilo, Giulia are hurt.

regDeaths.name: the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
A man, maybe 60s, with a buzz cut
